from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel

router = APIRouter(prefix="/projects/freelance")

class ProjectMilestoneResponse(BaseModel):
    project_id: str
    milestone_id: str
    deliverable_title: str

@router.get("/{project_id}/milestones/{milestone_id}", response_model=ProjectMilestoneResponse)
async def get_milestone_details(
    project_id: str,
    milestone_id: str,
    project_svc: ProjectService = Depends(get_project_service),
    contractor: ContractorUser = Depends(get_contractor_user)
):
    milestone = await project_svc.find_milestone(project_id, milestone_id)
    if not milestone:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Milestone not found")
    if milestone.assigned_contractor_id != contractor.id and not contractor.is_agency_partner:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Forbidden: contractor is not assigned to this milestone")

    return ProjectMilestoneResponse(
        project_id=milestone.project_id,
        milestone_id=milestone.id,
        deliverable_title=milestone.title
    )
